SELECT
  f.external_id                 AS facility_id,
  f.name                        AS facility_name,
  geo.name                      AS geo_organization,
  inst.eaushadhi_institute_id   AS institute_id,
  inst.eaushadhi_institute_name AS institute_name,
  st.eaushadhi_store_id         AS store_id,
  st.eaushadhi_store_name       AS store_name,
  stloc.name                    AS store_location,
  sp.eaushadhi_warehouse_id     AS supplier_id,
  sp.eaushadhi_warehouse_name   AS supplier_name,
  sporg.name                    AS supplier_organization,
  CASE
    WHEN inst.id IS NULL THEN 'Not onboarded'
    WHEN st.id IS NULL
      OR sp.id IS NULL THEN 'Incomplete mapping'
    ELSE 'Configured'
  END                           AS dvdms_status
FROM
  facility_facility f
  LEFT JOIN emr_organization geo ON geo.id = f.geo_organization_id
  AND geo.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinstitute inst ON inst.facility_id = f.id
  AND inst.deleted = FALSE
  -- One store / one supplier per institute is enforced in the UI, not in the
  -- database (the only DB constraint is one *default* per institute). LATERAL
  -- + LIMIT 1 keeps this one row per facility even if that invariant slips.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      s2.id,
      s2.eaushadhi_store_id,
      s2.eaushadhi_store_name,
      s2.location_id
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsstore s2
    WHERE
      s2.institute_id = inst.id
      AND s2.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      s2.is_default DESC,
      s2.id
    LIMIT
      1
  ) st ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN emr_facilitylocation stloc ON stloc.id = st.location_id
  AND stloc.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      p2.id,
      p2.eaushadhi_warehouse_id,
      p2.eaushadhi_warehouse_name,
      p2.supplier_id
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmssupplier p2
    WHERE
      p2.institute_id = inst.id
      AND p2.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      p2.is_default DESC,
      p2.id
    LIMIT
      1
  ) sp ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN emr_organization sporg ON sporg.id = sp.supplier_id
  AND sporg.deleted = FALSE
WHERE
  f.deleted = FALSE
  AND f.is_active = TRUE
  -- Inherited from the original card. Drop this line to also list facilities
  -- that are not flagged public (is_public defaults to FALSE).
  AND f.is_public = TRUE
  [[AND f.external_id = {{facility_id}}::UUID]]
ORDER BY
  f.name;

-- DDC Activity (7 days)
-- One row per DDC (a facility location attached to a `pharmacy` healthcare
-- service). "Dispenses (7d)" counts completed patient dispenses in the 7-day
-- window ending on the dashboard's Date filter (inclusive, Asia/Kolkata);
-- 0 means the DDC saw no dispensing activity in that window.
WITH
  w AS (
    SELECT
      CASE LOWER(TRIM({{issue_date}}))
        WHEN 'today' THEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
        WHEN 'yesterday' THEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1
        ELSE {{issue_date}}::date
      END AS end_date
  )
SELECT
  loc.external_id                            AS location_id,
  loc.name                                   AS ddc,
  loc.status                                 AS location_status,
  t.last_dispense_date                       AS last_dispense,
  (w.end_date - t.last_dispense_date)        AS days_since_last_dispense,
  COALESCE(t.dispenses_7d, 0)                AS dispenses_7d
FROM
  w
  CROSS JOIN facility_facility f
  JOIN emr_facilitylocation loc ON loc.facility_id = f.id
  AND loc.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      MAX(
        (
          COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)
          AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
        )::date
      ) AS last_dispense_date,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
          (
            COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)
            AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
          )::date BETWEEN (w.end_date - 6) AND w.end_date
      ) AS dispenses_7d
    FROM
      emr_medicationdispense md
    WHERE
      md.location_id = loc.id
      AND md.deleted = FALSE
      AND md.status = 'completed'
      AND (
        COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)
        AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
      )::date <= w.end_date
  ) t ON TRUE
WHERE
  f.deleted = FALSE
  AND f.external_id = {{facility_id}}::UUID
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM
      emr_healthcareservice hs
    WHERE
      loc.id = ANY (hs.locations)
      AND hs.deleted = FALSE
      AND hs.internal_type = 'pharmacy'
  )
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(t.dispenses_7d, 0) DESC,
  loc.name;

-- Issues to Patient (per location)
-- One row per issue. An "issue" is a DispenseOrder: a dispensing event for one
-- patient at one location, grouping N MedicationDispense line items.
-- Filters: Issue Date (single day, Asia/Kolkata), Facility ID, Location ID.
-- Location ID is optional - leave it blank for all DDCs in the facility.
WITH
  w AS (
    SELECT
      CASE LOWER(TRIM({{issue_date}}))
        WHEN 'today' THEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
        WHEN 'yesterday' THEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1
        ELSE {{issue_date}}::date
      END AS end_date
  ),
  dispensed AS (
    SELECT
      -- DispenseOrder is nullable on a dispense. Orderless dispenses get their
      -- own negative key so each stands alone instead of collapsing together.
      COALESCE(dord.id, -md.id)                 AS issue_key,
      COALESCE(dord.external_id, md.external_id) AS issue_id,
      loc.external_id                           AS location_uuid,
      loc.name                                  AS location_name,
      pat.external_id                           AS patient_uuid,
      (
        COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)
        AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
      )::date                                   AS issued_on,
      md.quantity                               AS quantity
    FROM
      w
      CROSS JOIN emr_medicationdispense md
      JOIN emr_facilitylocation loc ON loc.id = md.location_id
      AND loc.deleted = FALSE
      JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = loc.facility_id
      AND f.deleted = FALSE
      JOIN emr_patient pat ON pat.id = md.patient_id
      AND pat.deleted = FALSE
      LEFT JOIN emr_dispenseorder dord ON dord.id = md.order_id
      AND dord.deleted = FALSE
    WHERE
      md.deleted = FALSE
      AND md.status = 'completed'
      AND f.external_id = {{facility_id}}::UUID
      AND (
        COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)
        AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
      )::date = w.end_date
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT
          1
        FROM
          emr_healthcareservice hs
        WHERE
          loc.id = ANY (hs.locations)
          AND hs.deleted = FALSE
          AND hs.internal_type = 'pharmacy'
      )
      [[AND loc.external_id = {{location_id}}::UUID]]
  )
SELECT
  issue_id        AS issue_id,
  issued_on       AS issue_date,
  location_uuid   AS location_id,
  location_name   AS ddc,
  patient_uuid    AS patient_id,
  COUNT(*)        AS no_of_items,
  SUM(quantity)   AS total_quantity
FROM
  dispensed
GROUP BY
  issue_key,
  issued_on,
  location_uuid,
  location_name,
  issue_id,
  patient_uuid
ORDER BY
  location_name,
  issue_id;

-- Issue Detail (line items)
-- One row per dispensed line item. Drills into the Issue Summary card:
-- Issue Date + Facility ID are required; Location ID and Issue ID are optional
-- (blank = all DDCs / all issues for that day).
--
-- DVDMS drug identity is resolved from two sources, in order:
--   receipt   - the DVDMS inward item actually delivered into this inventory
--               item (exact: matches on supplied_inventory_item_id, so it is
--               specific to this product AND this location)
--   catalogue - care_dvdms_dvdmsproductmapping for the product knowledge, used
--               when there is no DVDMS receipt behind the stock
WITH
  w AS (
    SELECT
      CASE LOWER(TRIM({{issue_date}}))
        WHEN 'today' THEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
        WHEN 'yesterday' THEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1
        ELSE {{issue_date}}::date
      END AS end_date
  )
SELECT
  (
    COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)
    AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
  )::date                                      AS issue_date,
  loc.external_id                              AS location_id,
  loc.name                                     AS store,
  COALESCE(dord.external_id, md.external_id)   AS issue_id,
  pat.external_id                              AS patient_id,
  pk.name                                      AS product,
  COALESCE(rcpt.drug_name, map.drug_name)      AS drug_name,
  md.quantity                                  AS quantity,
  COALESCE(prod.batch ->> 'lot_number', rcpt.batch) AS batch_no,
  COALESCE(
    (prod.expiration_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date,
    rcpt.expiry_date
  )                                            AS expiry,
  COALESCE(rcpt.drug_id, map.drug_id)          AS drug_id,
  COALESCE(rcpt.brand_id, map.brand_id)        AS drug_brand_id
FROM
  w
  CROSS JOIN emr_medicationdispense md
  JOIN emr_facilitylocation loc ON loc.id = md.location_id
  AND loc.deleted = FALSE
  JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = loc.facility_id
  AND f.deleted = FALSE
  JOIN emr_patient pat ON pat.id = md.patient_id
  AND pat.deleted = FALSE
  JOIN emr_inventoryitem ii ON ii.id = md.item_id
  AND ii.deleted = FALSE
  JOIN emr_product prod ON prod.id = ii.product_id
  AND prod.deleted = FALSE
  JOIN emr_productknowledge pk ON pk.id = prod.product_knowledge_id
  AND pk.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN emr_dispenseorder dord ON dord.id = md.order_id
  AND dord.deleted = FALSE
  -- Provenance: the DVDMS inward item delivered into THIS inventory item.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      d.drug_id,
      d.brand_id,
      d.name AS drug_name,
      iir.batch,
      iir.expiry_date
    FROM
      emr_supplydelivery sd
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsrecorditemdelivery rid ON rid.supply_delivery_id = sd.id
      AND rid.deleted = FALSE
      AND rid.status <> 'REVERSED'
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinwarditemrecord iir ON iir.id = rid.inward_record_item_id
      AND iir.deleted = FALSE
      LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsrecorditemorder rio ON rio.id = iir.record_order_item_id
      AND rio.deleted = FALSE
      LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsdrug d ON d.id = rio.drug_id
      AND d.deleted = FALSE
    WHERE
      sd.supplied_inventory_item_id = md.item_id
      AND sd.deleted = FALSE
      AND sd.status = 'completed'
      AND sd.created_date <= COALESCE(
        md.when_handed_over,
        md.when_prepared,
        md.created_date
      )
    ORDER BY
      sd.created_date DESC
    LIMIT
      1
  ) rcpt ON TRUE
  -- Catalogue: the institute's DVDMS mapping for this product knowledge.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      d2.drug_id,
      d2.brand_id,
      d2.name AS drug_name
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsproductmapping pm
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinstitute inst ON inst.id = pm.institute_id
      AND inst.deleted = FALSE
      AND inst.facility_id = f.id
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsdrug d2 ON d2.id = pm.drug_id
      AND d2.deleted = FALSE
    WHERE
      pm.product_knowledge_id = pk.id
      AND pm.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      (pm.mapping_type = 'manual_mapping') DESC,
      pm.usage_count DESC,
      pm.last_used_date DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT
      1
  ) map ON TRUE
WHERE
  md.deleted = FALSE
  AND md.status = 'completed'
  AND f.external_id = {{facility_id}}::UUID
  AND (
    COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)
    AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
  )::date = w.end_date
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM
      emr_healthcareservice hs
    WHERE
      loc.id = ANY (hs.locations)
      AND hs.deleted = FALSE
      AND hs.internal_type = 'pharmacy'
  )
  [[AND loc.external_id = {{location_id}}::UUID]]
  [[AND COALESCE(dord.external_id, md.external_id) = {{issue_id}}::UUID]]
ORDER BY
  loc.name,
  COALESCE(dord.external_id, md.external_id),
  pk.name;

-- Stock Transfers (sent & received)
-- One row per completed supply delivery line. Same shape as Issue Detail, but
-- the counterparty is a store rather than a patient.
--
-- Filters: Issue Date + Facility ID required; Location ID and Drug ID optional.
--   Location ID matches EITHER side - a store's sent and received rows both
--   appear when you filter by it.
--   Facility scope is "origin OR destination belongs to the facility", so a
--   transfer received from another facility shows up here too.
--
-- DVDMS drug identity resolves in two steps:
--   receipt   - the DVDMS inward item tied to this exact supply delivery
--               (care_dvdms_dvdmsrecorditemdelivery.supply_delivery_id)
--   catalogue - care_dvdms_dvdmsproductmapping for the product knowledge,
--               which is what internal store-to-store transfers fall back on
WITH
  w AS (
    SELECT
      CASE LOWER(TRIM({{issue_date}}))
        WHEN 'today' THEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
        WHEN 'yesterday' THEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1
        ELSE {{issue_date}}::date
      END AS end_date
  )
SELECT
  (sd.created_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS transfer_date,
  orig.external_id                             AS from_store_id,
  COALESCE(orig.name, sup.name)                AS from_store,
  dest.external_id                             AS to_store_id,
  dest.name                                    AS to_store,
  pk.name                                      AS product,
  COALESCE(d.name, map.drug_name)              AS drug_name,
  sd.supplied_item_quantity                    AS quantity,
  COALESCE(prod.batch ->> 'lot_number', iir.batch) AS batch_no,
  COALESCE(
    (prod.expiration_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date,
    iir.expiry_date
  )                                            AS expiry,
  COALESCE(d.drug_id, map.drug_id)             AS drug_id,
  COALESCE(d.brand_id, map.brand_id)           AS drug_brand_id
FROM
  w
  CROSS JOIN facility_facility f
  CROSS JOIN emr_supplydelivery sd
  JOIN emr_deliveryorder dor ON dor.id = sd.order_id
  AND dor.deleted = FALSE
  JOIN emr_facilitylocation dest ON dest.id = dor.destination_id
  AND dest.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN emr_facilitylocation orig ON orig.id = dor.origin_id
  AND orig.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN emr_organization sup ON sup.id = dor.supplier_id
  AND sup.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN emr_inventoryitem ii ON ii.id = sd.supplied_inventory_item_id
  AND ii.deleted = FALSE
  JOIN emr_product prod ON prod.id = COALESCE(ii.product_id, sd.supplied_item_id)
  AND prod.deleted = FALSE
  JOIN emr_productknowledge pk ON pk.id = prod.product_knowledge_id
  AND pk.deleted = FALSE
  -- Receipt provenance: one-to-one with this supply delivery, so no guessing.
  LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsrecorditemdelivery rid ON rid.supply_delivery_id = sd.id
  AND rid.deleted = FALSE
  AND rid.status <> 'REVERSED'
  LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinwarditemrecord iir ON iir.id = rid.inward_record_item_id
  AND iir.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsrecorditemorder rio ON rio.id = iir.record_order_item_id
  AND rio.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsdrug d ON d.id = rio.drug_id
  AND d.deleted = FALSE
  -- Catalogue fallback: the institute's mapping for this product knowledge.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      d2.drug_id,
      d2.brand_id,
      d2.name AS drug_name
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsproductmapping pm
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinstitute inst ON inst.id = pm.institute_id
      AND inst.deleted = FALSE
      AND inst.facility_id = f.id
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsdrug d2 ON d2.id = pm.drug_id
      AND d2.deleted = FALSE
    WHERE
      pm.product_knowledge_id = pk.id
      AND pm.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      (pm.mapping_type = 'manual_mapping') DESC,
      pm.usage_count DESC,
      pm.last_used_date DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT
      1
  ) map ON TRUE
WHERE
  sd.deleted = FALSE
  AND sd.status = 'completed'
  AND f.deleted = FALSE
  AND f.external_id = {{facility_id}}::UUID
  AND (
    orig.facility_id = f.id
    OR dest.facility_id = f.id
  )
  AND (sd.created_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = w.end_date
  [[AND (
    orig.external_id = {{location_id}}::UUID
    OR dest.external_id = {{location_id}}::UUID
  )]]
  [[AND COALESCE(d.drug_id, map.drug_id) = {{drug_id}}]]
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(orig.name, sup.name),
  dest.name,
  pk.name;
